rationale: Reviewed the full round-2 BRIEF, my round-1 verdict, the cb272d50 diff, resulting spec and ADR-0045, and the relevant trust-boundary code in a scratch clone pinned to cb272d508cfe1ef85582e9cea6c085bb196bbc63. All three of my round-1 asks are addressed, including the deliberately narrowed selection contract. The new design does not grant stored metadata claim authority, retains exact git corroboration, and explicitly accepts agent-writable audit inputs under ADR-0037. One new contract ambiguity remains: R4.3 extends the binding-contradiction veto to both identification and reattest, without preserving reattest's existing independently git-derived, audited replacement of a contradictory binding. This should be resolved before implementation. Nine focused existing lifecycle tests passed, as did two real-git review-only fallback-emulation cases. A real bd 1.1.0 scratch database confirmed the relevant JSON shapes. Spec validation exited 0 with one lifecycle-binding warning and no errors. These are grounding and design probes, not tests of an implementation of spec 129. The source repository was not modified.
concrete_changes_required: Clarify spec.md R4.3 (currently line 272) and the planned ADR-0041 Amendment (Spec 129): a contradictory landed binding must veto automatic FindLandedMerge/FindLandedMergeReachable identification, while explicit ReattestLandedMerge may replace it only with the independently scan-derived exact identity after its ownership, ambiguity, surviving-tip and revert checks pass, recording the prior pair in the audit. Preserve TestReattest_ContradictoryBindingOverwrittenAudited and TestReattest_StaleOlderRemergeBindingRewrittenToNewest, and add an AC covering the same audited repair with a non-corroborating panel set and a reachable-fallback candidate. Keep the automatic binding-contradiction and no-write-on-reattest-refusal cases pinned.

findings.title: Round-1 ask status
findings.detail: G2.1 — ADDRESSED by an explicit change of contract: R1.1/R3/OQ-9 no longer advertise metadata-only beads as selectable; R1.2 names them as near-misses, AC-2 proves the detached plan-form recovery, and R1.8/AC-6 require lineage-spec versus claim-spec equality before mutation. The current EvaluateReadiness still resolves lineage and requires a dotted bead index, so this narrowing matches the real downstream boundary. G2.2 — ADDRESSED: R4.1 now defines status-independent plan-form OR dependency-entry spec_id OR parent membership, forbids title inference, and makes read/parse errors FAIL rather than not-applicable PASS; AC-10(d)/(e)/(g) pin the previously missing metadata-only, parent-only and read-error cases. I verified dependency-entry metadata in real bd 1.1.0. G2.3 — ADDRESSED: R6.2 disallows flagless claims entirely, R6.3 specifies schema-2 admission and legacy/malformed/error handling, and AC-16/17 pin scope narrowing, detail-digest matching and invalid-marker cases. Evidence text is deliberately removed from the marker; sha/path/byte shape validation is an audit contract, with read-time content verification expressly out of scope. That is sufficient because no marker authorizes a claim. No round-1 ask is PARTIAL or MISSED. The separate binding-repair finding is a NEW_ISSUE in the revised R4.3 wording.

findings.title: R4.3 conflates the automatic binding veto with explicit audited binding repair
findings.detail: R4.3 introduces its rule as applying in FindLandedMerge and ReattestLandedMerge, then says an exact (b) surviving-tip or (d) binding contradiction still contradicts, whatever the other legs say (spec.md:267–272). For automatic identification this is the necessary fail-closed rule. Reattest intentionally has a different relationship to the old binding: internal/lifecycle/reattest.go:330–375 independently derives the exact owned candidate and overwrites an inconsistent or stale binding, recording the previous values. TestReattest_ContradictoryBindingOverwrittenAudited passed in the scratch clone, explicitly proving a contradictory pair must be replaced rather than kept; the adjacent stale-older-remerge test pins convergence to the newest identity. No wording in the revised spec exempts this repair from the newly shared veto, and AC-12 covers only absent or correct bindings. Implementing the shared veto literally removes that recovery; silently keeping current repair leaves the requirement ambiguous at a trust boundary. Make the automatic-versus-explicit distinction explicit, while retaining every independent git and no-write-on-refusal guard.

findings.title: Trust-boundary probes and refutations
findings.detail: The metadata spec_id, override marker and evidence justification remain writable by any authorized bd user/agent; panel registrations remain repository-writable, and merge-subject ownership trusts the git-history writer under ADR-0041. Evidence sha256 records a snapshot, not the truth or authority of its author. A registration matching the second parent is corroboration, not a panel-approval verdict; stale or abandoned registrations are not newly authenticated by set lookup. These are accepted limits, not requests for signatures or protected storage. Nine existing real-git lifecycle tests passed: spoofed-subject/wrong-second-parent, ancestor-only panel, forged nonexistent binding, binding to another bead, forged binding to a real anonymous merge, inconsistent binding pair, masked-revert identification, contradictory-binding audited reattest, and masked-revert reattest. The scratch-only TestG2R2ReachableTrustProbe emulates R4.2 through the candidate seam: the current primary scan returned NoCandidate on both off-first-parent fixtures; the proposed exact-format reachable scan identified the intact landing and refused the reverted landing in both identification and reattest. This does not prove all future fallback cases. Both relevant refutations were checked: registerLandedPanel exists at internal/validate/readiness/fixtures.go:189 and currently uses a fixed slug; a real scratch bd 1.1.0 ready result carried parent and metadata together when set, and bd show dependency entries carried metadata but no parent. Captures are bd-probe/g2-ready-shapes.json and bd-probe/g2-bd-shapes.json under this reviewer's scratch directory. The clone validator reported only [WARN] lifecycle-binding: spec has no beads epic; run spec approve to create one, with exit 0. No lifecycle mutation was run on the source repository.
